frameScript: new Promise(resolve => { const start=performance.now(), intervals=[], tasks=[]; let galleryFrames=0, missingFrames=0; let last=0, done=false, timer=0; const observer=new PerformanceObserver(list=>{for(const e of list.getEntries())tasks.push({duration:e.duration,start:e.startTime-start});}); observer.observe({type:'longtask',buffered:false}); const finish=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);const sorted=intervals.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b),q=p=>sorted[Math.min(sorted.length-1,Math.floor(sorted.length*p))]||0;resolve({window:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,visibility:document.visibilityState},elapsed:performance.now()-start,sceneValid:missingFrames===0&&galleryFrames>0,galleryFrames,missingFrames,frames:intervals.length,rafIntervalMs:{p50:q(.5),p95:q(.95),max:sorted.at(-1)||0},longTasks:tasks,totalLongTaskMs:tasks.reduce((s,e)=>s+e.duration,0)});};function frame(t){if(done)return;if(document.querySelector(".studio-unified")&&!document.querySelector("#cardZoom"))galleryFrames++;else missingFrames++;if(last)intervals.push(t-last);last=t;if(performance.now()-start>=3000)finish();else requestAnimationFrame(frame);}requestAnimationFrame(frame);timer=setTimeout(finish,5000);})
